name: setuptools
description: Python packaging and distribution library used to build and install Python modules, required by build tools such as Meson that still depend on the legacy setup.py interface.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
